name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana
description: Comprehensive incentive scheme by Government of Bihar supporting girl children from birth to graduate degree completion to stop female feticide and promote education.
descriptionHindi: कन्या भ्रूण हत्या रोकने, लिंगानुपात सुधारने और बालिकाओं को स्नातक तक शिक्षित करने हेतु बिहार सरकार की प्रमुख योजना।
ministry: Social Welfare & Education Department, Government of Bihar
benefits: Cumulative financial assistance up to ₹54,100: cash grants at birth, immunization, sanitary napkins, uniform grants, ₹25,000 upon passing 12th, and ₹50,000 upon graduation.
benefitsHindi: जन्म से स्नातक तक कुल ₹54,100 तक की सहायता, जिसमें 12वीं उत्तीर्ण पर ₹25,000 और स्नातक उत्तीर्ण पर ₹50,000 शामिल हैं।
eligibilityText: Girl children and students who are permanent residents of Bihar enrolled in recognized educational institutions.
eligibilityTextHindi: बिहार की मूल निवासी छात्राएं जो मान्यता प्राप्त शैक्षणिक संस्थानों से 12वीं या स्नातक उत्तीर्ण हों।
